evidence.text: Can natural scalar masses coexist with the weak gravity conjecture at very small gauge charge? The authors also seek a generalization to product Abelian groups and models in which a hypothetical fifth-force discovery could test electroweak naturalness.

sources.title: Scalar Fields, Hierarchical UV/IR Mixing and The Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the scalar-extended Weak Gravity Conjecture constrain a particle mass parametrically below the quantum-gravity cutoff, and could this reformulate scalar naturalness?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and Emergence from an Ultraviolet Cutoff

evidence.text: What upper bounds on the quantum gravity cutoff follow from charged sLWGC towers for general gauge groups, and can simultaneous strong gauge and gravitational interactions explain emergence or imply the WGC?

sources.title: Is the Standard Model in the Swampland? Consistency Requirements from Gravitational Scattering

evidence.text: Does the low cutoff inferred from QED plus gravity survive the inclusion of already known electroweak and strong interactions, and does its vanishing massless limit establish a general obstruction?

sources.title: De Sitter, gravitino mass and the swampland

evidence.text: Does the magnetic weak gravity conjecture obstruct controlled de Sitter critical points with vanishing gravitino mass, and does the vanishing-mass limit signal an EFT breakdown more generally?

sources.title: The generalized scalar weak gravity conjecture and its implications

evidence.text: Can a scalar weak gravity conjecture be formulated by comparing gravitational and scalar scattering amplitudes at arbitrary energies, for both massive and massless mediators, and then used to infer Higgs-sector new-physics scales and lower bounds on axion couplings?

sources.title: An Introduction to the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What precisely does the Weak Gravity Conjecture assert, what evidence supports it, and what would it imply for string-consistent effective theories and axion inflation? This is a pedagogical review, rather than a new general proof.

sources.title: Aspects of non-local QED and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Assuming the weak gravity conjecture applies to the chosen non-local QED model, what constraints follow for charged neutrinos and their non-locality scales, and how does the softened electric force modify a force-based WGC formulation?

sources.title: Localized Towers on the Composite Magnetic Monopole and the Weak Gravity Conjecture$=$Distance Conjecture Connection in Effective Field Theories

evidence.text: Does the magnetic weak gravity conjecture–distance conjecture connection descend through Higgsing to a lower-energy EFT, and can excitations localized on its composite magnetic monopole supply the relevant tower?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture in the asymptotical dS and AdS background

evidence.text: Can the weak gravity conjecture constrain gauge couplings, effective-field-theory cutoffs, and cosmological constants in asymptotically de Sitter and anti-de Sitter backgrounds, with a heuristic string-theory explanation?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for Noncommutative Field Theory

evidence.text: What weak-gravity restrictions follow for noncommutative U(1) gauge theories and scalar theories from the gravitational effects of their solitons, and under what conditions can these restrictions inform commutative theories?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture constraints on inflation

evidence.text: Can a scalar analogue of the weak gravity conjecture, formulated by comparing scalar and gravitational coupling corrections, constrain the UV cutoff and the field values or duration of inflation?

sources.title: Infinite Distances and the Axion Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can geometric constraints determine the coefficients required to turn parametric axion-WGC evidence into the precise normalized unit-ball bound?

sources.title: CP violation and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Introduce the CP-induced monopole electric charge g_e^ind ∼ θg_e, then assert a stronger cutoff constraint. For quantum hair, use a mixed topological coupling θF H̃ to obtain an analogous induced local electric charge and light-particle bound.

sources.title: Naturalness and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Generalizes black-hole decay kinematics using charge and energy conservation. Mass-fraction weights give Z=Σσ_i z_i with Σσ_i<1; convex geometry of particle and antiparticle charge-to-mass vectors translates this into a discharge criterion.

sources.title: Scalar Fields, Hierarchical UV/IR Mixing and The Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Motivations use long-range force balance, stable charged bound states, species counting and extremal-black-hole decay. Quantum control is explored with schematic one-loop estimates and a supersymmetric completion of the five-dimensional example.

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and Emergence from an Ultraviolet Cutoff

evidence.text: Estimate light-particle loop effects with λ_gauge(E)=e² E^(D−4) Σ_{m_i<E} I(i) and λ_grav(E)=G_N E^(D−2) Σ_{m_i<E} dim(R_i). Their order-one thresholds estimate upper cutoffs; the gravitational condition reproduces the species bound.

sources.title: Infinite Distances and the Axion Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Replace the exact periods by their nilpotent leading orbit after isolating unipotent monodromy, and restrict the approach to one growth sector. This removes exponentially suppressed period corrections without eliminating all path dependence.

sources.title: Is the Standard Model in the Swampland? Consistency Requirements from Gravitational Scattering

evidence.text: The reported workflow combines diagram and amplitude calculation with analytic loop-integral evaluation, followed by crossing, dispersive, and gauge-choice checks. It provides internal validation of the authors’ perturbative calculation, without exposing enough intermediate material for independent reproduction here.

sources.title: Some low dimensional evidence for the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can classical systems in 2+1 and 1+1 dimensions support the weak gravity relation m ≤ g/√G through regularity and gravitational backreaction, without relying on Planck-scale remnants or small black holes?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: How can an abelian interaction become weak while the original gravitational scale stays finite? The kinetic matrix relates this requirement to expanding subvarieties inside a fixed-volume three-fold.

sources.title: Magnetic Monopole Molecules

evidence.text: Which bound configurations of constituent Dirac monopoles form a unit-charge monopole of a surviving U(1), how can such configurations be assembled, and how does their internal gravitational stability bear on descent of magnetic WGC constraints?

sources.title: Testing the scalar weak gravity conjecture in no-scale supergravity

evidence.text: How should scalar weak gravity conjectures be formulated and tested using scattering in curved, multifield scalar geometries, and at which background field values are these tests meaningful?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture with Large Extra Dimensions

evidence.text: Does weak gravity constrain the UV cutoff of a four-dimensional, brane-localized U(1) theory through the fundamental higher-dimensional Planck scale, potentially placing that cutoff within collider reach?

sources.title: Revisiting the scalar weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: How should interactions of a neutral massive scalar be compared with gravity? The paper selects near-threshold scattering in flat spacetime with frozen spectator fields and small external kinetic energies.

sources.title: Swampland Variations on a Theme by KKLT

evidence.text: Can a magnetic weak-gravity bound independently reproduce the field-dependent throat cutoff using a gauge field associated with the light modes?

sources.title: Swampland bounds on magnetized extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can the Weak Gravity Conjecture (WGC), vacuum longevity and the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture (TCC) jointly constrain magnetic flux, compactification scale and string scale in models where flux determines the chiral generation count?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Must some charged object experience gauge repulsion at least as strong as gravitational attraction?

sources.title: A Brief Introduction to the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What do the electric and magnetic Weak Gravity Conjectures assert, what quantum-gravity motivations support them, and how are they refined for multiple gauge fields, massless scalars, extended charged objects, and broken supersymmetry?

sources.title: A Tale of Two $U(1)$'s: Kinetic Mixing from Lattice WGC States

evidence.text: Does the spectrum required by the sublattice Weak Gravity Conjecture, supplemented by genericity assumptions about masses, yield nonzero kinetic mixing between two Abelian gauge groups, and what magnitude should be expected?

sources.title: The Weak Scale from Weak Gravity

evidence.text: Can the electric weak gravity conjecture bound the electroweak scale parametrically below the Higgs-sector cutoff, while accommodating the magnetic WGC without trivializing that bound?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: How is the gauge weak-gravity cutoff altered when N separated abelian gauge sectors share the same bulk gravity?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Can the gauge coupling in a gravitational effective theory be arbitrarily weak without additional light states or a lower cutoff?

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: How do long-range scalar forces alter charge-versus-gravity constraints when gauge couplings and particle masses depend on massless moduli?

sources.title: The unbearable lightness of charged gravitini

evidence.text: Does the magnetic weak gravity conjecture obstruct controlled de Sitter backgrounds with charged gravitini whose Lagrangian masses vanish or are parametrically smaller than H, independently of scalar stability?

sources.title: The Internal Structure of the Deconstructed Dirac Monopole

evidence.text: What binds the fractional diagonal magnetic charges constituting a Dirac monopole in deconstructed U(1), what sets its spatial size, and does that internal scale affect the magnetic Weak Gravity Conjecture?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture in Asymptotically Safe Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can running gravitational and electromagnetic couplings in asymptotically safe quantum gravity modify charged-black-hole extremality so that the Weak Gravity Conjecture emerges from ultraviolet renormalization-group behavior?

sources.title: Gravitational correction and weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can comparing gravitational and gauge contributions to the running coupling provide a quantum-level interpretation of the weak gravity conjecture, including non-Abelian theories, higher dimensions and large extra dimensions?

sources.title: Fundamental Forces and Scalar Field Dynamics in the Early Universe

evidence.text: Do scalar weak gravity conjectures impose conditions resembling those for fragmentation of early-universe scalar condensates into Q-balls or oscillons?

sources.title: Weak-gravity bound in asymptotically safe gravity-gauge systems

evidence.text: Does the weak-gravity bound survive a complete four-gauge-field operator basis, additional vector species and gravitational gauge changes? Do gravitational fixed points evade it, including for 12 vectors, and does it still restrict spacetime dimensionality?

sources.title: Pair Production and Gravity as the Weakest Force

evidence.text: How can gravitational strength be compared with scalar interactions whose independent quartic contact terms are invisible to long-range force comparisons? The paper asks whether pair production extends weak-gravity reasoning beyond conserved gauge charges.

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Implications of Quantum Gravity for Particle Physics

evidence.text: Review how quantum-gravity consistency conditions constrain low-energy EFT and might inform strong CP, the weak scale, new gauge interactions and dark energy. The white paper explicitly does not guarantee that gravitational considerations solve these problems.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture and effective field theory

evidence.text: Does satisfying a Weak Gravity Conjecture in a higher-energy gauge theory ensure its validity after Higgsing, and what weaker constraint on gauge EFTs might survive when conventional WGC bounds fail?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Can many gauge sectors produce an arbitrarily weak diagonal force without changing gravity?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Does this abelian spectrum exhibit the charge sublattice expected from the Sublattice Weak Gravity Conjecture? The source reports maximally superextremal states on a spacing-eight sublattice in the F2 example.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Which weak gravity conjectures are supported by quantum gravity examples, what principles might explain them, and how strongly can they constrain effective theories?

sources.title: Spin-2 fields and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Does a genuine gauge interaction become too weak relative to gravity, permitting forbidden stable remnants or a global-symmetry limit?
